clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for flexible steel conduits for protection of cables in electrical installations. Such conduits shall not be used as an earth continuity conductor.

clauses.title: Strip steel used in
clauses.text: 2.1 Strip steel used in manufacture shall be of mild steel, bright, cold-rolled and annealed. Shall be electrogalvanized or electro-tinned to a minimum thickness of 0.0025 mm, or otherwise provided with equally effective protective coating.

clauses.title: Conduit shall be wound
clauses.text: 2.2 Conduit shall be wound tightly and the strip so overlapped in subsequent helicis that no openings are seen in normal position.

clauses.title: Internal surfaces shall be
clauses.text: 2.3 Internal surfaces shall be free from burrs and sharp edges.

clauses.title: Linear Breaking Test –
clauses.text: 4.2 Linear Breaking Test - Shall show no indication of yielding under a load less than that specified in above table maintained for 3 minutes when undergone the prescribed test.

clauses.title: Test for Flexibility –
clauses.text: 4.3 Test for Flexibility - Shall show no crack or flaws and shall return to normal position without damage to its outer or inner diameter.

clauses.title: Bend Fracture Test –
clauses.text: 4.4 Bend Fracture Test - Radius of bend shall be decreased until the yield point is reached under a load, not less than that specified in Table given in 3.

clauses.title: Crushing Test – There
clauses.text: 4.5 Crushing Test - There shall be no permanent distortion. Note - For test details, refer to 8 of the standard.
